text:
lina: quick sync — we need to lock down who owns which networking bits for customer-managed VPC routing before the PRD review tomorrow. scope: cross-account peering, route propagation, egress, and NAT behaviors.

devon: agree. main pain is route propagation timing + overlap handling. proposal: conservative defaults on our side, explicit customer opt-in for route import.

mike: for Dedicated we currently do peering + route table entries in customer account via a service user. question: do we let customers manage route tables fully, or only advertise prefixes and we write routes?

sofia: security note — if we write routes into customer account we need least-priv IAM role + KMS access audit. and we must require flow logs + SG baseline.

lina: acceptance criteria idea: 1) documented API for "advertise-prefixes" 2) fail-safe fallback to our managed NAT if route propagation fails >30s 3) end-to-end test that simulates CIDR overlap and rejects config.

devon: +1. also add edge-case: asymmetric routing when customer has on-prem VPN + our IGW; include MTU and DF behavior test.

mike: operational checklist: a) automated validation that prefix set doesn't intersect reserved ranges b) dry-run mode that shows proposed route table changes c) rollback if BGP session flaps.

sofia: must include threat model section: IP spoofing if customer misconfigures, requirement: require prefix ownership proof (TXT or signed assertion).

lina: concrete tasks: devon - add "route-propagation" & "fallback" sections to RFC; mike - draft deployment verification playbook; sofia - append security controls + acceptance tests; i'll update PRD acceptance matrix.

devon: will do. question on timing: is 30s fallback enough? some customers have slow route table convergence. maybe make fallback-configurable with recommended 30s default.

mike: yes make configurable. default 30s, warn if >2m. add metric: route_convergence_seconds to telemetry.

lina: rollout plan: canary to 3 existing beta tenants, run traffic test for 12h, then expand. must include runbook for manual failover to our managed egress.

sofia: also require signed config upload and audit log retention 90d for Private deployments.

deploy-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/rfcs/-/merge_requests/512 — devon updated route-propagation.md, awaiting reviews from mike, sofia.

devon: pushed draft with sample configs (snippet below):
```
advertise_prefixes: ["10.20.0.0/16"]
fallback: { enabled: true, timeout_seconds: 30 }
```

lina: nice. final ask: include a tiny e2e script we can run from customer side to validate connectivity and routing — add to docs and add acceptance test in CI.

mike: i'll own the e2e script and the canary plan. target to have playbook + tests by EOD Friday.

sofia: i'll review RFC and add security checklist by Thursday.

lina: thanks all — i'll consolidate tasks in the PR and tag product review. :thumbsup:
